evidence: SnO x ALD is performed in a commercial Microchemistry F120 system using a growth temperature of 95, 120, or 150 °C, TDMASn as the metal precursor, and H 2O as the counter reactant. 14 A cycle sequence of TDMASn/N 20purge/H 2O/N 20purge with pulse times of 0.4/2/0.4/2 s respectively is used for the SnO x ALD
